subject: English
passage: A primary objective of the Community Health Partnership (CHP), a nonprofit organization established in 1998, is to improve healthcare access for underserved populations. The CHP achieves this objective in part by focusing on training programs. By having experienced healthcare professionals serve as instructors, the CHP gives new medical workers the benefits of both clinical expertise and professional development. Many organizations provide similar types of training to new generations of teachers, social workers, and other service professionals, suggesting that ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: many organizations recognize the importance of providing opportunities for new professionals to learn from experienced instructors.
choices.B: professionals of all experience levels benefit more from clinical expertise than from professional development.
choices.C: most experienced professionals could become even better at their jobs by serving as instructors.
choices.D: finding an instructor is more important for medical workers than it is for teachers, social workers, and other types of professionals.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it presents the conclusion that most logically follows from the text's discussion of the relationship between the CHP's use of instructors to support new medical workers and similar training that other organizations offer their new professionals. According to the text, in service of CHP's goal to improve healthcare access, CHP instructors provide beneficial expertise and development to new workers. The text goes on to say that many other organizations support new professionals in similar ways, suggesting that these organizations recognize the importance of providing opportunities for new professionals to learn from instructors who are experienced in their field.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. Although the text indicates that instructors are beneficial to new medical workers and that new people pursuing other kinds of service work (including teaching and social work) can also find instructors through organizations, the text gives no indication that instructors are more important for medical workers than for other types of professionals.
